patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index ae82d26340..d23f305ecc 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -214,6 +214,7 @@ class Collector:
         if collect_related:
             if keep_parents:
                 parents = set(model._meta.get_parent_list())
+            related_fields = []
             for related in get_candidate_relations_to_delete(model._meta):
                 # Preserve parent reverse relationships if keep_parents=True.
                 if keep_parents and related.model in parents:
@@ -221,28 +222,44 @@ class Collector:
                 field = related.field
                 if field.remote_field.on_delete == DO_NOTHING:
                     continue
-                batches = self.get_del_batches(new_objs, field)
+                related_fields.append((related, field))
+            if related_fields:
+                # The batch size only depends on the number of objects, not on
+                # the relation itself, so it can be computed once. Fast
+                # deletes targeting the same related model within a batch are
+                # combined with OR to reduce the number of DELETE queries.
+                batches = self.get_del_batches(new_objs, related_fields[0][1])
                 for batch in batches:
-                    sub_objs = self.related_objects(related, batch)
-                    if self.can_fast_delete(sub_objs, from_field=field):
-                        self.fast_deletes.append(sub_objs)
-                    else:
-                        related_model = related.related_model
-                        # Non-referenced fields can be deferred if no signal
-                        # receivers are connected for the related model as
-                        # they'll never be exposed to the user. Skip field
-                        # deferring when some relationships are select_related
-                        # as interactions between both features are hard to
-                        # get right. This should only happen in the rare
-                        # cases where .related_objects is overridden anyway.
-                        if not (sub_objs.query.select_related or self._has_signal_listeners(related_model)):
-                            referenced_fields = set(chain.from_iterable(
-                                (rf.attname for rf in rel.field.foreign_related_fields)
-                                for rel in get_candidate_relations_to_delete(related_model._meta)
-                            ))
-                            sub_objs = sub_objs.only(*tuple(referenced_fields))
-                        if sub_objs:
-                            field.remote_field.on_delete(self, field, sub_objs, self.using)
+                    fast_deletes = {}
+                    for related, field in related_fields:
+                        sub_objs = self.related_objects(related, batch)
+                        if self.can_fast_delete(sub_objs, from_field=field):
+                            related_model = related.related_model
+                            if related_model in fast_deletes:
+                                fast_deletes[related_model] = (
+                                    fast_deletes[related_model] | sub_objs
+                                )
+                            else:
+                                fast_deletes[related_model] = sub_objs
+                        else:
+                            related_model = related.related_model
+                            # Non-referenced fields can be deferred if no
+                            # signal receivers are connected for the related
+                            # model as they'll never be exposed to the user.
+                            # Skip field deferring when some relationships are
+                            # select_related as interactions between both
+                            # features are hard to get right. This should only
+                            # happen in the rare cases where .related_objects
+                            # is overridden anyway.
+                            if not (sub_objs.query.select_related or self._has_signal_listeners(related_model)):
+                                referenced_fields = set(chain.from_iterable(
+                                    (rf.attname for rf in rel.field.foreign_related_fields)
+                                    for rel in get_candidate_relations_to_delete(related_model._meta)
+                                ))
+                                sub_objs = sub_objs.only(*tuple(referenced_fields))
+                            if sub_objs:
+                                field.remote_field.on_delete(self, field, sub_objs, self.using)
+                    self.fast_deletes.extend(fast_deletes.values())
             for field in model._meta.private_fields:
                 if hasattr(field, 'bulk_related_objects'):
                     # It's something like generic foreign key.
